contents.name: ProofKind

enumValues.name: SHA256_RSA2048_PSS
enumValues.description: SHA-256 with RSA 2048 PSS. Non-deterministic signature: the same hash signed with the same key does not create the same signature.

enumValues.name: SHA256_RSA2048_PKCS1
enumValues.description: SHA-256 with RSA 2048 PKCS#1 v1.5. Deterministic signature: the same hash signed with the same key always creates the same signature.

enumValues.name: SHA256_ECDSAP256_RFC3279
enumValues.description: SHA-256 with ECDSA NIST P-256, RFC 3279 (DER) encoding. Non-deterministic variable-size signature: the same hash signed with the same key does not create the same signature, and the signature size varies. See https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc3279

enumValues.name: SHA256_ECDSAP256_IEEEP1363
enumValues.description: SHA-256 with ECDSA NIST P-256, IEEE P1363 (fixed r||s) encoding. Non-deterministic fixed-size signature: the same hash signed with the same key does not create the same signature, but the size is always the same.

enumValues.name: MLDSA44
enumValues.description: ML-DSA-44 (FIPS 204), NIST security category 2. Signature is 2420 bytes, public key 1312 bytes. Non-deterministic (hedged) fixed-size signature; the payload is passed to ML-DSA as the message with an empty context string and is not pre-hashed by the signature scheme.

enumValues.name: MLDSA65
enumValues.description: ML-DSA-65 (FIPS 204), NIST security category 3. Signature is 3309 bytes, public key 1952 bytes. Non-deterministic (hedged) fixed-size signature; the payload is passed to ML-DSA as the message with an empty context string and is not pre-hashed by the signature scheme.

enumValues.name: MLDSA87
enumValues.description: ML-DSA-87 (FIPS 204), NIST security category 5. Signature is 4627 bytes, public key 2592 bytes. Non-deterministic (hedged) fixed-size signature; the payload is passed to ML-DSA as the message with an empty context string and is not pre-hashed by the signature scheme.
